gettingStarted.title: 🎉 Your herd is ready!
gettingStarted.description: You have {{count}} animals loaded. Here's what you can do:

startPlan.title: What you can unlock
startPlan.subtitle: Every record you add turns on an analysis that's already built.

animals.benefit: To have the whole herd in one place
animals.unlocks: Stock by category, individual profiles and every report.

corrals.benefit: To know which paddock performs best
corrals.unlocks: Corral comparison, stocking rate and paddock ranking.

weights.benefit: To know how many kilos a day each animal is gaining
weights.unlocks: Average daily gain (kg/day), estimated weight, herd ranking and alerts when an animal stalls.

vaccines.action: Set up the health calendar and log the first dose
vaccines.benefit: So the system warns you before anything expires
vaccines.unlocks: Herd vaccination coverage, due-date alerts and pending boosters.

genealogy.action: Record sire and dam for your animals
genealogy.benefit: To avoid mating relatives by accident
genealogy.unlocks: Genealogy tree, inbreeding coefficient and genetic score.

reproduction.action: Record services, pregnancy checks and calvings
reproduction.benefit: To know which cows give you a calf every year
reproduction.unlocks: Pregnancy and calving rates, days open and reproductive ranking.

finances.benefit: To know what the herd actually leaves you
finances.unlocks: Result per period, cost per animal and financial reports.

settingsRow.title: Watch the tour again
settingsRow.description: We'll show you again what each part of Agrodeo is for.

welcome.title: Let me show you Agrodeo in 2 minutes
welcome.body:
Just a few short screens so you know what you can do with the app.

You can leave whenever you want and watch it again from Settings.

animals.title: Keep your whole herd in one place
animals.body:
Add each animal once and you get its full record: weight, history, health and both parents.

Search by tag and see everything that happened to it.
animals.where: Find it in the Animals menu.

corrales.title: Know which paddock performs best
corrales.body:
See how many animals are in each pen and how they are growing.

That way you decide better where to move the herd.
corrales.where: Find it in the Pens menu.

weights.title: Know how much each animal gains
weights.body:
With two weigh-ins the app works out how many kilos a day each animal gains.

It also flags the ones that stopped growing, before you lose money.
weights.where: Find it in the Activities menu.

health.title: Never miss a vaccine again
health.body:
Set the calendar once and the app warns you before each vaccine is due.

Every record stays saved for official reporting.
health.where: Find it in Settings and in the Activities menu.

reproduction.title: Know when each cow will calve
reproduction.body:
Add services and inseminations and the app estimates the calving date and builds the calving calendar.

It also flags the empty ones.
reproduction.where: Find it inside each animal's record, in the Animals menu.

finances.title: Know what each kilo gained cost you
finances.body:
Add expenses and sales and the app shows you the clear number.

It's the fastest way to see if the year worked out.
finances.where: Find it in the Finances menu.

reports.title: See how the herd is doing
reports.body:
Track month-by-month progress, compare pens and get the ranking of your best animals.

Export everything to Excel if you need it.
reports.where: Find it in the Reports menu.

offline.title: It works without signal
offline.body:
You can add data out in the field with no internet.

It's saved on your phone and uploaded on its own once you have signal again. Nothing gets lost.

assistant.title: Ask anything about your herd
assistant.body:
Write to it in plain words, like talking to a person, and it answers using your own data.

For example: how many cows are pregnant, or which animal gained the most.

contact.title: Any questions? Write to me
contact.body:
There's a real person on the other side, not a form. I answer the same day.

If something isn't clear or you want help loading your data, write to me.
